historical_runtime_disposition.reason: The immutable raw attempts contain the required model, inference, direct metric, profiler, and cleanup fields; only the closure validator was fail-open.

defects.finding: A different syntactically valid model artifact digest was accepted because the validator did not bind the evidence to the frozen manifest and model file bytes.
Request, success, and inference counts below the frozen value of 100 were accepted, and GPU execution relied on a summary boolean instead of raw runtime evidence.
Prometheus count zero, missing data, or mismatched attempt/model identity was not independently rejected.
Cleanup validation ignored orphan_count and did not require every residue dimension to be exactly zero.
Issue register, umbrella description, and progress claim text still described E0 as not run after runtime evidence reached review_pending.

rca_summary: The v1 evidence projection validated hashes and summary shape but did not independently parse and enforce the immutable model manifest, Triton direct metrics, attempt-scoped Prometheus samples, GPU instance log, CUPTI fields, and complete cleanup residue set.
next_action: Add a versioned fail-closed validator, mutation regressions, strict reprojection, one non-credit current-revision smoke, and a new review_pending handoff.
claim_boundary: one Windows/WSL2 physical node, one RTX 4080, controlled traffic; no production SLA, HA/DR, multi-GPU/MIG/MPS, Triton-overlap, or customer-traffic claim
